implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired GVR study by iterating deterministic, Dockerized Batfish validation runs in CPU-only hosts and hosted model API calls. Operational plan: split the preregistered N=200 intents into four deterministic execution_batches of 50 intents each (seeded splitting); for each batch: (1) call hosted LLM (model=gpt-5-mini) once per intent to produce the initial proposal; (2) baseline arm: canonical parser applied and accepted if parsable; (3) guarded arm: canonical parser -> Batfish Docker validation; if Batfish flags any severity, invoke up to two repair prompts within the same batch workflow but counting repairs toward model-call totals only when within the adapter's per-batch budget; to respect the adapter contract, each execution batch is sized to task_count=50 with per-batch estimated_model_calls=100; all validation, scoring, contamination detection, flagging, and exclusion are deterministic code paths. All Batfish runs use a versioned public Docker image; all code, seeds, prompts, and logs are archived.
model_and_version_plan: Primary execution model (hosted API endpoint): gpt-5-mini (model_name and model_version set to gpt-5-mini per adapter manifest).
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered curated corpus of 200 intents (public-sourced and synthetic/curated examples). Deterministically split into four seeded batches of 50 (seed=2026, partition algorithm: round-robin after deterministic shuffle) to produce per-batch task manifests; each batch's manifest lists task_indices 1..50 and is archived with hash.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply deterministic text normalization, vendor-neutral canonical parsing, AST generation, AST semantic equivalence checks (round-trip parse), and removal of non-config commentary. All transformations implemented as deterministic code modules; canonical parser configuration snapshot and unit tests published and archived.
randomisation_plan: No random arm assignment (paired design). Deterministic shuffle of full 200-intent corpus using seed=2026 to produce batch allocation; within each intent the initial generation is deterministic (seeding protocol encoded in prompts and orchestration).
caching_plan: Cache and archive 100% of model responses, canonical parser outputs, Batfish validator logs, ASTs, and transformation traces to local persistent storage (hashed). Reuse cached outputs only for reproducibility replays; no cached-based decision altering primary execution.
failure_recovery_plan: Infrastructure/API failures: do not issue additional automatic model-generation retries beyond the adapter-permitted single attempt per call. If a hosted-model API or Batfish Docker invocation fails for an intent such that both arms cannot be completed deterministically, mark the pair as 'technical failure' and exclude from primary confirmatory analysis; all technical failures, timestamps, error codes, and hashes are recorded. Repair-attempt failures follow the pre-specified per-intent repair budget; if repair prompts cannot be executed due to provider outage, mark intent technical-failure. These deterministic rules are enforced by orchestration code (no human adjudication).
result_schema: Each recorded pair outcome is a paired_binary_episode_v1 record: fields include intent_id, batch_id, initial_model_output, parsed_baseline_proposal, baseline_acceptance_flag, baseline_accepted_proposal_hash, baseline_Batfish_outcome_if_executed, guarded_final_proposal_hash, guarded_acceptance_flag, guarded_Batfish_outcome, repair_attempts_count, suspect_prompt_gaming_flag, technical_failure_flag, timestamps, and deterministic severity label (high-severity binary).
estimated_compute_notes: Per-adapter authoritative per-batch counts: task_count = 50 intents per execution batch; estimated_model_calls per batch = task_count * 2 = 100 (one initial generation used by both arms counts as 1 call per intent; worst-case repairs and sensitivity runs are budgeted within batch caps). Planned full-study totals derived from execution_batches: 4 batches * 50 intents = 200 total confirmatory intents; total planned model calls = 4 * 100 = 400 model calls. Dockerized Batfish runs: one validator invocation per parsed proposal; validator CPU execution budget modest (single-container per batch). All totals satisfy capability_manifest.maximum_planned_model_calls=10000 and wall-clock budget (7 days) given hosted-model API availability and CPU Batfish runs.
